exposure: history of vaginal birth after C/S (VBAC)
outcome: success of trial of labour after one caesarean section (TOLAC)
cohort: 237 women with previous one C/S who were selected for a trial of labour
finding: The trial of labour after one caesarean section is a safe alternative to repeated C/S and decreases the associated morbidities with repeated C/S.
mod_finding: Higher maternal & fetal complications rates were reported in cases delivered by emergency C/S compared to those who delivered vaginally or through elective C/S.
